verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (R2017 era, signal processing / OCT imaging script)
verdict.provenance_detail: Hand-written research script for OCT (Optical Coherence Tomography) raw stack data reading, Hilbert transform filtering, and numerical focusing
verdict.purpose: Reads raw binary image stack data from a PhotonFocus camera, performs row/axial binning, FFT-based bandpass filtering, Hilbert transform (via inverse FFT of filtered spectrum), axial and lateral averaging, deep signal enhancement, auto-brightness normalization, and saves B-scan images as PNG files for OCT numerical focusing experiments.
